notes.title: 关于近日玩家对《漫展模拟器》一些疑问的正式说明
notes.content:
近日，我们从多个渠道了解到部分玩家对《漫展模拟器》游戏以及开发者大谷的质疑，现针对大家所关心的几个问题做以下说明：

[h1]Q1：众筹的持续时间、有多少人参与及完成了多少金额？
[/h1]A：《漫展模拟器》的众筹于2018年3月25日~5月24日在摩点网进行，完成了46,599元的众筹款，这个结果离不开来自多个平台686位热心玩家的信任和支持。

[h1]Q2：众筹的宣传是否只在一个平台发布？
[/h1]A：尚未敲定发行商之前，无论b站还是所有参与过宣传的网站，《漫展模拟器》都发布了关于众筹的文章和游戏介绍视频，这些大家可以在大谷各平台账号发布的内容中看到。

[h1]Q3：我参与了众筹，钱能退款吗？
[/h1]A：各位众筹过的用户可通过游戏客服QQ号800059038咨询退款事宜。无论玩家是否申请退款，我们都将感谢大家对我们的支持，所以所有参与众筹的玩家权益都将保留。

[h1]Q4：还会有未授权的形象吗？
[/h1]A：大谷在游戏Alpha版里使用了一些自己画的游戏、动画和电影的角色，本意是致敬经典。但与bilibili签订代理发行协议后，大谷本人第一时间通过微博发布消息，确定这些角色将不会出现在未来上线的正式版本中。

最后，大谷制作游戏的初衷，来源于和所有ACG同好一起分享快乐，这也是我们重视《漫展模拟器》的缘由。我们对大家的支持和信任都将报以真挚的感谢，也对之前造成的误解表示诚挚的歉意。希望能借此机会消除大家的误解，也提前预祝大家2019年元旦快乐！

开发者大谷 & 《漫展模拟器》发行团队敬上

notes.title: Gamescom's over and see you next con!
notes.content:
After five unforgettable joyful days in Cologne, finally, it came to the end of Gamescom 2018. Now, please keep up the pace with me and review our journey to Gamescom together (๑╹◡╹)ﾉ"""

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/9a11b7378fd7da1b5ae95aa7807bdb4119b24498.gif[/img]

Let me show you guys our little stand first~

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/5348289677ed4b0fc4d4b93d8a82b011a5b35537.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/80690dfef33e76cc6c987b511f022fe6af1f2fc0.jpg[/img]

At Gamescom 2018, we brought our latest game demo with many cute gifts (it's our mascot,actually) prepared for our guests.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/2e1735d8b2574084b1f70cedcbea0f352698f009.gif[/img]

What is the feeling of organizing a comic con on Gamescom? We believe that many buddies who came to our stand have experienced (｀・ω・´)

Some buddies expressed their favor of comic con that the game is so attractive and they couldn’t stop playing it. Super thanks for the feedback from our passionate guests! All feedbacks and suggestions were kept carefully. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/726f4f6cf7d66efb42a0fe65991cf28a87efb37e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/9c1939692aea4ab01ddc40a6b872cafd559c8d37.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/42b3ea48c78a9f7c3d61ad53589f8d96c836e29b.png[/img]

We also welcomed many little guests attracted by our very cartoon style interface.We believe one day these little guys are probably going to be the bosses of many gaming events (￣▽￣)／

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/24b4e67f68f9113605b9adc6ae0d5372477da306.jpg[/img]

There were also many Bilibili users came to our stand and took pictures with our logo. Look at the pictures carefully, can you find yourself in them?

Many thanks to all of yo! We will keep going with your support and try our best to become better and better （づ￣3￣）づ╭❤～

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430592/abb646739b099088f42a0bc5873f462dad0af781.jpg[/img]

Good times pass by amazingly quick. Five days were too short to share enough with you guys. Hope we could bring more fun to you next time! Let’s look forward to our next con show! ヾ(◍°∇°◍)ﾉﾞ
